prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 3 tests agree after noise correction (-3.5% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) tend to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-1.8% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across tests.
Evidence remains thin for home flows (home, new_flow) with only 1 test, and predictions were consistently overly optimistic.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Narrative Split Layout: Redesign the story screen into a split layout separating the app intro narrative from setup options. (why: Story step has high drop-off before path selection and long average time (514s mean in choose_path step).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Screen Account Recovery Notice: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to log in with their original account to preserve existing pets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.)
2: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Format Guidance Badge: Add an explicit photo guidance hint and recommendation badge on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or incorrect visual output, and adoption step drop-off is high at 60.9%.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Interaction Sound & Mascot: Add time estimation and an animated mascot with calm ambient sound to the waiting screen during pet creation. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean time of 2336s, causing user drop-off.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Controls Quick Reference: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a checklist layout outlining key desktop interactions. (why: 3 support tickets noted post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Spotlight Mode: Switch the choose path screen layout to spotlight mode to emphasize each companion path clearly. (why: Choose path step conversion is 76.2% with a mean completion time of 514s.)
6: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Notification: Enable desktop notification options on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet setup is complete. (why: Waiting mean time is 2336s, indicating users switch away to other desktop tasks during background processing.)
7: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Companion Voice & Sound Preview Flow: Introduce video and sound preview components on the friend pick screen so users can hear pet audio before selecting. (why: Pick friend step takes median 89s and contributes significantly to the 39.1% drop-off in adoption.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Screen Security & Sync Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that signing in saves pet customization and syncs across devices. (why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and multiple support emails reported lost pets due to account confusion.)

scores.note: Choose path redesigns historically show neutral effect (0.0%), and no support email points to narrative issues.
High evidence with 8 support emails reporting pet loss at sign-in. Simple hint config change.
Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%) and 3 support emails report photo format issues.
Home drop-off is relatively low (18.7%); adding mascot and sounds requires full new assets.
Strong evidence from emails/funnel, but finish redesigns/new screens consistently regressed (-3.5%).
Target step drop-off is moderate, and past path selection redesigns showed no clear benefit.
Addresses high background waiting time (2336s mean), though evidence is funnel-only.
Adoption step loses 39.1%, but new adoption flows historically regressed conversion (-1.8%).
Config-only copy change backed by multiple support tickets regarding account sync confusion.
